title: Hardware & USB Tethering Manager
summary: USB status first, then the operations menu. Drivers install as Android, iOS, or the full suite.

items.title: Install Drivers (RNDIS / CDC-Ether / NCM)
items.description: Installs the kernel modules OpenWrt needs before a phone can appear as a USB network device. 1 is RNDIS, CDC-Ether and CDC-NCM. 2 is ipheth and usbmuxd. 3 is both plus QMI, MBIM and usb-modeswitch.
items.usage_tip: Run this before Setup USB Tethering. Install only the phone you use. The full suite is the larger option.

items.title: Setup USB Tethering
items.description: Creates network.wan_usb (proto dhcp) on a detected tethering device, adds it to the firewall wan zone and brings it up.
items.usage_tip: Install drivers first. If the phone is in MTP mode, enable USB Tethering on the phone. Creating the interface anyway requires an explicit yes.

items.title: Failover & Metrics Configuration
items.description: Lists wan, wan_usb, wan6 and other WAN interfaces with their metrics. Choosing one writes network.<iface>.metric.
items.usage_tip: A lower metric is preferred. Enter on the metric prompt leaves that interface unchanged.

items.title: Toggle Interface Status
items.usage_tip: Create the interface with option 2 before toggling it.

items.title: Restore / Reset USB Stack
items.description: After confirmation, deletes wan_usb, its device binding and firewall membership, then restarts the network service. A second prompt can uninstall the USB driver packages.
items.usage_tip: Enter keeps the current configuration. Enter on the package prompt keeps the drivers installed.

items.title: Modem Mode Switch
items.description: Lists modems still in storage mode with usbmode -l and switches them with usbmode -s.
items.usage_tip: Needs usb-modeswitch from the full driver profile.

items.title: Refresh
items.description: Redraws the dashboard from the current USB and UCI state.
items.usage_tip: Use this after enabling USB Tethering on the phone.

items.title: System Resources
items.usage_tip: RAM and flash figures come from the live router.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
